I’m Doc Jess, a licensed veterinarian sharing real cases, pet health tips, clinic experiences, and honest conversations every furparent should know. From daily consultations and surgeries to emergencies, diagnostics, and preventive care—this channel is all about education, awareness, and compassionate pet care.

🎥 What you’ll see here:
• Real-life vet cases (educational & ethical)
• Pet health tips every furparent should know
• Behind-the-scenes at Pawprint Vet
• Emergency signs you should never ignore
• Vet life stories—no filters, just facts

Whether you’re a furparent, aspiring vet, or animal lover, this channel is for you.

🐶🐱 Because pets are family.
📍 Pawprint Veterinary Clinic
👍 Like • Subscribe • Share
